Search for homes listed for sale in a specific location. Returns paginated results with up to 41 listings per page, including property details like price, beds, baths, area, zestimate, and location coordinates. Uses Zillow's internal search API which resolves the location string to a geographic region. Optional pet_friendly, has_yard, has_pool, and keywords filters all narrow results through Zillow's listing keyword search, which matches words in the listing description and features (Zillow has no dedicated pet, yard, or pool checkbox for sale listings); when several are supplied they are combined into one keyword search, so a listing must match all supplied terms. A keyword-narrowed search can legitimately return an empty listings array with totalResultCount 0. Each call costs three upstream requests (location lookup, region bounds, search).

Search for rental properties in a specific location. Returns paginated results with up to 41 listings per page, including building-level and unit-level rental data with price ranges, availability counts, and amenity information. Each listing is either an individual rental (numeric zpid, price '$N/mo', beds/baths, availabilityDate when the landlord set one, hdpData) or an apartment building (isBuilding true, a latitude--longitude id in zpid, a units array of per-floor-plan price ranges). Optional furnished=true applies Zillow's 'Furnished' rental filter and narrows the result set (e.g. 294 to 168 in Laguna Beach, CA). Pass a numeric zpid from listings[*].zpid to get_rental_details for lease length, deposits and application requirements. Each call costs three upstream requests (location lookup, region bounds, search).

Apartment-building results (isBuilding true, latitude--longitude ids) are not supported by this endpoint. One upstream page request per call; a zpid that is not an active rental (e.g. a for-sale home) or does not exist yields a not-found input error.

A listing with no scheduled open house legitimately returns an empty openHouses array and openHouseCount 0. One upstream page request per call; an unknown zpid yields a not-found input error.
